text.title: Afterglow
text.declared_mood: Uneasy, watchful → pressurized, spiraling → surrender, eruptive
text.production_notes: Sub-heavy dub bass with slow LFO movement, Sparse kick with off-grid accents, Rimshots drenched in delay, High shimmering textures evoking cosmic radiation, Granular synths flickering like background relic signals, Tape delay throws that smear phrases into echoes, Gradual increase in distortion and saturation, Stereo field widening into disorientation, Final drop: overwhelming low-end + collapsing high frequencies, engulfing mix
text.vocal_notes: Intimate, close-mic androgynous vocal, Slight tremble in sustained notes, Layered whispers panned wide like surrounding thoughts, Occasional spoken-word fragments processed with dub delay, Low octave doubles creeping in during moments of dread, Final section strained, breaking, almost shouted through reverb
section_names: Intro – distant hiss-like textures | faint pulses | space-like ambience
Verse 1 – minimal beat enters | tight, uneasy rhythm
Pre-Hook – dub echoes widen | rising harmonic tension
Hook – deeper bass enters | wider stereo | haunting
Verse 2 – more rhythmic movement | layered textures
Hook – heavier bass | more vocal layering
Build – distortion creeps in | rhythm destabilizes
Drop – explosive | saturated bass | overwhelming layers
Verse 3 – frantic energy | broken phrasing | rising intensity
Final Hook – shouted, breaking | massive soundstage
Outro – collapsing mix | bass overwhelms | high-end disintegrates
